## Narrative

EC-Council (International Council of E-Commerce Consultants) operates the **CEH** (Certified Ethical Hacker), CHFI (computer forensics), ECSA (security analyst), and LPT (licensed pentester) certs. The CEH credential has high name recognition in HR + compliance hiring; community opinion varies on technical depth vs OSCP/OSWE. [CONFIRMED]
